description: Ministry of Justice - Order made to extend the Operation Date of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act
categorisation: This gazette content is a notification under Section 7(5) of the Code of Criminal Procedure (Special Provisions) Act, No. 2 of 2013. It formally announces the parliamentary approval date for a ministerial order extending the operation of this specific Act. This falls squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory" classification as it deals with the implementation and extension of existing legislation, specifically a criminal procedure act, which is a legal/regulatory matter.
